terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s word, from the name in the modern languages; he prints it with an i, written here as consonantal j, as the house writes major. The botanists’ name is Carica papaya (Linnaeus).

phrases.english: A papaya is ripe when it turns yellow.

phrases.latin: Dīmidium papajae tibi dabō; sēmina nigra cochleāre exime.
phrases.english: I’ll give you half a papaya; scoop out the black seeds with a spoon.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. papaya.
